item.title: Kenosha Police take gun from 16-year-old high school student after struggle
item.description: A police officer took a loaded gun from a 16-year-old student during a struggle at Kenosha high school early Wednesday. The post Kenosha Police take gun from 16-year-old high school student after struggle appeared first on WPR.

item.title: UW-Madison Dean Eric Wilcots named interim chancellor
item.description: The Dean of the College of Letters & Science will lead Wisconsin's flagship university in May when Chancellor Jennifer Mnookin leaves for Columbia University. The post UW-Madison Dean Eric Wilcots named interim chancellor appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin lawmakers weigh competing bills to regulate wakesurfing, wake boats
item.description: Wisconsin Republican lawmakers have put forth dueling bills to regulate wakesurfing and operation of wake boats, one of which is receiving a hearing Wednesday. The post Wisconsin lawmakers weigh competing bills to regulate wakesurfing, wake boats appeared first on WPR.

item.title: State Supreme Court hears arguments over college minority grant program
item.description: The Wisconsin Supreme Court heard oral arguments on Wednesday about whether undergraduate retention grants for certain minority students are constitutional. The post State Supreme Court hears arguments over college minority grant program appeared first on WPR.

item.title: ‘End of an era’: Milwaukee processing plant to close later this year, affecting 221 workers
item.description: Cargill Meat Solutions Corp. filed a layoff notice with the state Department of Workforce Development on Tuesday. The company says it plans to permanently close its "protein processing plant" on South Emmber Lane in Milwaukee. The post ‘End of an era’: Milwaukee processing plant to close later this year, affecting 221 workers appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin native speedskater Jordan Stolz wins the 1,000 meters gold in an Olympic-record time
item.description: The 21-year-old didn’t threaten his world record of 1:05.37 but did better than the Olympic standard of 1:07.18 that had stood since 2002 — before Stolz was born. The post Wisconsin native speedskater Jordan Stolz wins the 1,000 meters gold in an Olympic-record time appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Bill would limit rent hikes in Wisconsin mobile home parks
item.description: Democratic lawmakers propose capping annual rent increases and adding other resident protections as corporate ownership expands in manufactured home communities. The post Bill would limit rent hikes in Wisconsin mobile home parks appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin Senate passes bills restricting transgender athletes, banning gender transition surgeries for minors
item.description: Wisconsin Senate Republicans passed a series of bills Wednesday aimed at restricting gender transition surgeries for minors and which sports teams transgender students can join.
